items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: and on the drums was Sonny Greer

ctx.x: That's okay, it's probably written down someplace. Who was in Duke's band when you joined it?

When I joined Duke Ellington in the Cotton Club, it was Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Wetzel, Phil Jenkins, Cootie Williams, Freddie Guy, a guitar player, and we had Otto Hardwick, Hiwork, saxophone, Johnny Hodges, and Carney, and on the drums was Sonny Greer, and the bass player was that fellow from New Orleans, what's his name?

items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Puerto Ricans, Tizol, an old Puerto Rican. Yeah, we had everybody.

ctx.x: Because you all had -- like you had Creoles in the band. You had West Indians, you had --
Puerto Ricans, Tizol, an old Puerto Rican. Yeah, we had everybody. And like I say, it was a family. We had Creoles, Puerto Ricans, Indians. Yeah.
